title: SSS at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detection of Online Sexism using Majority Voted Fine-Tuned Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Hierarchical classification of social media posts into binary (sexist vs. not sexist) and fine-grained categories (e.g., threats, derogation, animosity) using fine-tuned transformer ensembles (DeBERTaV3, RoBERTa) evaluated via Macro F1 score.
